title: Savoury Crepes
summary: Thin French crepes with no sugar in the batter, unlike sweet dessert crepes. Use them to wrap a Beef Wellington or serve them with savoury fillings.

steps.text: Whisk the flour, eggs, milk, melted butter and salt in a bowl until smooth. Leave the batter to rest for {timer:30}.
Heat a non-stick frying pan over a medium-high heat and butter it lightly.
Pour a small ladleful of batter into the pan and swirl to coat the base thinly.
Cook for {timer:1-2}, until the edges start to brown, then flip and cook for another 30 seconds.
Stack the crepes on a plate with greaseproof paper between each one.
Leave to cool completely before using for a Wellington, or refrigerate overnight.

tips: The key to thin crepes is to use very little batter and swirl it quickly. The first crepe is often imperfect; that is normal. You can make the crepes the day before and refrigerate them with greaseproof paper between each one. For a Wellington, you will need about 10 crepes to wrap a 1 kg fillet.
